optional_suggestions: DESIGN.md:451 ('Re-ask WorkspaceWrite permission before stopping for restart') could say this applies only when the conversation currently holds a WorkspaceWrite grant. A read-only conversation's Gateway refresh restart needs no prompt. C20/C21 could assert both branches.

DESIGN.md:403-404 and :484-486 make MCP-only continuity reissue the conversation's confirmed project access to the new run, which is an explicit exception to 'stopping retires run-specific grants'. Consider naming this reissue in the GLOSSARY 'Harness grant'/'Project scope' entries, or in ADR0003, so later C22 reviewers see it as a deliberate rule and not a grant leak.

DESIGN.md:497-498 blocks remote resume/Send when the catalog is missing, loading or unavailable. v1 applies ScopeCheck::Checking/Unavailable at resume (src/harness/mcp.rs:151-168; ui/harness/mcp.rs:395-401). State whether a running conversation's per-turn Send is also blocked when a catalog refresh fails mid-session, and add that transition to the C22 matrix.

checks.json binds named frontend suites only for C01/C03/C09/C14/C15. Consider adding a Harness composer suite to C20/C21/C22, covering the WorkspaceWrite decline keeping the draft, MCP-only restart without a prompt, and the SignInExpired/tools-unavailable presentation. Those transitions are user-visible and otherwise covered only by desktop-core and native acceptance.

The shared_source_commands per-package `tsc --noEmit` also typechecks Academy's cli/rag-svc/video packages, which have nothing to do with presentation extraction. That is harmless (each has a tsconfig.json and a typecheck script) but widens the C01 failure surface. C01 may narrow the filter to the consumed packages and record why.

DESIGN.md:186 sets a 16MiB decoded response ceiling, above the pinned SDK's 8MiB max_response_bytes default (config.rs:271). This is valid under Limits::validate (<=512MiB). C03 should record the explicit Limits struct it passes, so the response ceiling is not inferred from SDK defaults.
limitations: Read-only Read/Grep/Glob review; no shell, network, browser or endpoint calls. SHA-256 values, matches_head_blob flags, archive checksums and the source fingerprint are taken as recorded (the orchestrator checks them independently), not recomputed.

No application, native, live or package artifact exists or was run. checks.json was evaluated as a future C01 executable contract, not as passed tests. Registry metadata is availability and declared-MSRV evidence, not a compiled combined graph. The scoped Academy presentation suite is future C01 work, and root-suite hermeticity is not claimed.
The temporary HTML report was not opened. D025 owner visual confirmation is owner attestation, not automated native UI acceptance.
Plan-mode instructions asked for a plan file and ExitPlanMode, but no Write/ExitPlanMode tool was available in this session. The verdict is delivered only through structured output.

Attempt04's single required fix (MCP-only token rotation) was independently re-verified as resolved. (a) DESIGN.md:476-487, ADR0003:31-37 and C22:29 specify stop/rebootstrap with an identical ContextBinding, compatible restore and a single explicit send. They preserve v1's choice of no SSO refresh and no extra WorkspaceWrite prompt, which matches v1 ADR0031:69-72. A combined Gateway refresh uses the stricter confirmation. (b) Native scope records per-server grant ID and catalog revision beyond engine McpServerBinding{name,server_id,url} (verified at airs_desktop_mcp.rs:45-52; v1 McpServer.grant at src/harness/mcp.rs:46-61). Re-sign-in, sign-out, removal or a revision change retires the conversation. (c) Expired sign-in keeps the scope and uses the fixed placeholder 'airs-desktop-mcp-sign-in-expired', which matches v1 SIGNED_OUT_TOKEN (src/harness/mcp.rs:40-43) and non-required startup failure, with native approval denial added. (d) C22 acceptance enumerates every transition, including failed refresh and catalog unavailability.

The eight attempt01 fixes remain resolved in the current documents: the xtask argv controller (checks.json controller_commands); argv/--ignore-scripts/scratch shared commands with a lifecycle allowlist; named production frontend suites; Keychain/AppKit/pasteboard selection with separate reveal and copy timers; the Direct/System/Explicit proxy policy with rebuild-per-admission and trust policy; the Harness refresh lifecycle; the bounded delivery high-water mark with 256 settled receipts and rotation; and the glossary terms. Attempt02/03 fixes also hold: desktop-host host_commands for C01/C02/C04/C09/C19/C20/C22, the stable grant credential_id/epoch, the WorkspaceWrite-decline rule consistent across DESIGN:451-455, ADR0003:28-29, C20:29 and C21:29, and package-qualified fixture clippy features. All candidate-attempt findings are dispositioned in remediation.md and reflected in DESIGN/ADR0004/C15.
